evals.prompt: this logo is from a screenshot and its really blurry, can you recreate it properly as an svg? dont just trace it. its for a video so i need a clean png too
evals.expected_output: Searches for a sharper original, measures the logo (symmetry/grid), builds geometry + live text from a spec, verifies with an overlay, delivers SVG + transparent PNG + fonts and an honest report.

evals.prompt: I ran this client's logo through an auto vectoriser and it looks terrible, the small text is just blobs. They don't have the original file. Can you get me a good quality version?
evals.expected_output: Does not deliver a trace. Looks for the original online first, then rebuilds by measurement with the lettering as live text in a matched open-licence font.

evals.prompt: need a vector of this wordmark-only logo (no symbol, just the company name in two lines with a line under it). only have a 300px jpg
evals.expected_output: Recognises there is no rotational symmetry, skips averaging, measures rows and the rule directly, matches the typeface with the fit test, builds and checks.
